name: viberaven-production-skills
description: Production skills for AI-built apps: GitHub/Vercel go-live, RLS, webhooks, env sync, auth callbacks, monitoring signal, release review, and launch readiness.

interface.shortDescription: Give agents production workflows, context, and evidence boundaries.
interface.longDescription: A plugin-style skill pack for AI coding agents that need to connect GitHub/Vercel, implement, repair, review, or verify RLS, webhooks, env vars, callbacks, monitoring, release diffs, and launch readiness.
defaultPrompt: Use VibeRaven Production Skills while working on this production-sensitive task.
Use go-live when the user wants GitHub push, Vercel deploy, official auth/dashboard handoff, and live URL proof.
Run the launch-readiness skill and list missing provider evidence.
Use release-review for auth, billing, database, env, monitoring, and provider risk.
